title: SN TOOL STUDIO PRO - Release v2.0.1 (Turbo Downloader 5x-10x Speed Boost & Parallel Engine)
subtitle: Turbo Downloader update (v2.0.1) is available with 5x-10x parallel speed boost, 85s timeout fix, and ShortMax 16-worker acceleration.
release_notes:
• 🚀 Turbo Parallel Downloader Boost: Increased episode concurrency from 2 to 5 threads in parallel, dramatically cutting download time by 5x-10x across entire drama series!
• 🛡️ 85s Hard Timeout Unlocked: Eliminated abrupt yt-dlp timeout kills on large video streams with smart dynamic streaming buffers.
• ⚡ Intelligent Stall Detection: Active network byte monitor kills dead/hanging streams within 20s instead of freezing for minutes.
• 🎬 ReelShort & Full Movie Slicing Fix: Corrected single-episode stream resolution to prevent pseudo master slicing loops.
• 💨 Chunked Stream Skipping: Prevented unnecessary fallback delays on .m3u8 playlist streams.
• 🌟 ShortMax Turbo Boost: Accelerated TS segment downloading and decryption from 8 to 16 concurrent workers.
